color.note: Chalk & Brass. Warm slate surfaces, chalk for text and the single accent, brass only for what was earned. Dark is the shipped theme; light ("pencil on paper") is the same tokens inverted and is verified, not shipped. Every pair below was checked in both themes; the table is in the Colour section.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. The slate. Every tab, the session runner and the cardio runner sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels and cards (the Quest card, stat tiles, the set card, list rows). One step up from the page; separated by `line`, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sheets, inputs, the rest-timer bar, menus, the tab bar and status strip. The highest everyday surface.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected fills (a chosen check-in option, an active segment), progress tracks, skeleton blocks, hover on desktop.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, row dividers, the status strip rule. Carries no meaning, so no contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control: inputs, secondary buttons, steppers, switches off, outlined tiles. 3:1 on surface-0, -1, -2 and -3 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: body copy, headings, numerals, button labels on surface-0 to -3. The chalk mark on slate (graphite on paper in the light theme).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: reason lines, cues, sublabels, tab labels at rest, the tagline. 4.5:1 on surface-0 to -3.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, locked-title requirements, footers, disabled labels. 4.5:1 on surface-0 to -2; on surface-3 only at 24px and up.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on a fill that is dark in BOTH themes: the danger button and the light theme's graphite primary button. Never on the surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-on-light
tokens.usage: Text on a fill that is light in BOTH themes: the bronze, silver and gold rank tiles, brass fills, the dark theme's chalk primary button.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, active tab, links, the selected ring in a segmented control, the focus ring, the current set dot. Chalk in the dark theme, graphite in the light one: the accent is the mark you make on the material, not a hue.

tokens.name: on-chalk
tokens.usage: Label on a chalk fill (the primary button). Aliases ink-on-light in the dark theme and ink-on-dark in the light theme.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Earned things, as text and strokes: XP numerals, the [RECORD], [LEVEL UP] and [RANK TRIAL] tags, the shield when a streak is protected, the brass hairline under a promotion. 4.5:1 on every surface. Brass appears only when something was earned, never as decoration.

tokens.name: brass-fill
tokens.usage: Earned things as fills: the XP bar, the level bar in the reward sheet, a Rank Trial set highlight. Same as brass in the dark theme; a lighter gold in the light theme so the bar stays gold and brass text stays readable.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a brass fill, both themes (dark ink).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the error boundary line ("Something broke. Your data is safe."). Destructive and broken only; never for a down-delta, a missed day or a reduced tier.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: The danger button fill (Delete account, Reset data). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (bone in both themes).

tokens.name: tier-full
tokens.usage: FULL tier: the label and outline of the tier badge. Aliases chalk: a full day is the baseline, drawn in the UI's own material; only a scaled day carries a hue.

tokens.name: tier-reduced
tokens.usage: REDUCED tier: sand. Label and outline of the tier badge and the tier word in a day-detail sheet. Warm and quiet, never amber or red: a reduced day still pays in full.

tokens.name: tier-recover
tokens.usage: RECOVER tier: slate-blue. Label and outline of the tier badge.

tokens.name: tier-rest
tokens.usage: REST tier: mauve. Label and outline of the tier badge, and the rest-day marker in the week strip.

tokens.name: rank-e
tokens.usage: Rank E, slate: letter and outline of the rank tile. The starting material; neutral, not dim.

tokens.name: rank-d
tokens.usage: Rank D, moss: letter and outline of the rank tile.

tokens.name: rank-c
tokens.usage: Rank C, copper: letter and outline of the rank tile.

tokens.name: rank-b
tokens.usage: Rank B, bronze: the first FILLED tile; the letter is ink-on-light. The same metal as C, now solid.

tokens.name: rank-a
tokens.usage: Rank A, silver: filled tile; the letter is ink-on-light.

tokens.name: rank-s
tokens.usage: Rank S, gold: filled tile with an inset hallmark frame in ink-on-light. A paler gold than brass so the two read as kin, not as the same token.

tokens.name: rank-edge
tokens.usage: Border of the three filled rank tiles. Transparent in the dark theme (the fills already stand 3:1 off the surfaces); line-control in the light theme, where silver and gold sit close to paper.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of every ProgressBar (XP, objective, rest timer) and the skeleton block. Aliases surface-3.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a sheet or dialog. Alpha hex; the only translucent token.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus-visible ring: 2px solid, offset by a 2px gap of the surface colour (see shadow `focus-ring`). Aliases chalk; 3:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Mono: numbers, ranks, tags, titles
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono is the structural voice: every number that is data, every rank letter, tier label, bracket tag and screen title. Monospaced, so every numeral is tabular by construction. Weights 500 and 600 only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The rest and cardio timers; the new level number in a level-up; the rank letter inside a 96px promotion tile.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Stepper values (load, reps, seconds); the XP total on the Quest cleared sheet; the rank letter in a 56px tile.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Stat tile values; the large rank badge on Stats; "+130 XP" in the cleared state of the quest button.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles (Quest, Stats, Profile), the session name in the runner, the segment name in the cardio runner. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Data inline with 16px copy: level and XP lines, objective progress ("0/12 sets"), XP values ("+120 XP"), the week strip numbers.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Compact data lines: the target line, record rows, quest-log rows, the sync count, stat deltas.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase. Bracket tags, tier badge labels, stat names, day-marker letters, section eyebrows. The only uppercase style; add text-transform: uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: badge
styles.sample: E D C B A S
styles.usage: The rank letter inside the 24px status-strip tile. Larger tiles scale the letter: 22px at 40, 32px at 56, 56px at 96.

groups.name: Sans: everything people read
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans is the human voice: sentences, labels, buttons, inputs. Same superfamily as the mono, so the two share x-height and stroke and sit on one line without fuss. Weights 400, 500 and 600. Its lining figures are tabular by default.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sheet titles, the exercise name in the runner, the Stats section headings, the title of an empty state.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Slept poorly + very sore: Reduced quest. One set less per lift. Same XP.
styles.usage: The reason line, descriptions, the notice sentence after a tag, dialog bodies, and every text input (16px stops iOS zooming).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, objective and settings row labels, check-in row labels, the selected option in a segmented control.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Elbows tucked, pause on the chest.
styles.usage: The cue line under an exercise, hints under inputs, the second line of a row, locked-title requirements.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Segmented-control options, overflow-menu items, the secondary action in a sheet footer, "View all".

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab labels, timestamps, footers, helper text. The floor: nothing in the product is set smaller than 12px.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Touch targets are 44px minimum, 48px for buttons, 56px for the stepper controls and the sticky primary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a tag and its sentence; between set dots; icon-to-label inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and pills; between a label and its value; between stacked lines in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list; between an input and its hint; row padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet padding; the page gutter at 390px; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; between the objective list and the primary button.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a tab; the gap above the week strip; sheet top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the reward lines and the summary row on the cleared sheet; between the landing playground and the benefits.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above the wordmark on the landing page; around the promotion tile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The 1024px breakpoint's column gutter; between a screen title and an empty state.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Clearance under a sticky primary button so content can scroll past it; the bottom inset of the session runner.

radius.note: Square-shouldered. Corners are soft, never round, except dots and pills, whose radius is half their height.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, tier badges, the 24px rank tile, segmented-control segments, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, the 40px and 56px rank tiles, the rest-timer bar, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, stat tiles, the set card, dialogs, the 96px promotion tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The top corners of a bottom sheet; the landing playground.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Set dots, day markers, the switch track and knob, the sync dot, the sheet grabber.

shadow.note: Surfaces are flat and separated by hairlines. Shadow exists in exactly three places: under a sheet, under a toast, and as the focus ring. Nothing glows.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A bottom sheet and a dialog, so they lift off the scrim. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: The record toast and the offline toast. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid focus. Applied as box-shadow on :focus-visible so it follows the radius; never on :focus alone.

zIndex.note: Seven layers, 10 apart, so a surface is never improvised between two others. Full-screen flows (the runners) replace the tabs rather than stacking above them.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The status strip, the tab bar, the sticky Complete-set button, the sticky Save in the cardio runner.

tokens.name: z-timer
tokens.usage: The rest-timer bar, which rides above the sticky primary.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Confirm dialogs, above any sheet that opened them.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The record toast and the offline toast, above everything but a promotion.

tokens.name: z-takeover
tokens.usage: The promotion takeover and the error boundary.

size.note: Control and hit sizes, so the 44px rule is a token, not a memory.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable, including icon-only controls and set dots (padded to 44 even when drawn at 12).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, segmented controls and check-in rows.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the stepper buttons and the sticky primary in the session runner.

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: Height of the status strip.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Height of the tab bar, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Content column at the 1024px breakpoint; centred.
